value: {"about.hero.eyebrow":"All about us","about.hero.title":"We are committed to tackling plastic pollution.","about.hero.intro":"Over 9 years of environmental action in Côte d’Ivoire, working for young people, communities and the planet.","about.plastic.title":"Protecting the environment and reducing plastic pollution","about.plastic.text1":"We are working to reduce the impact of plastic waste and promote lifestyles that respect the planet. In Côte d’Ivoire, we carry out clean-up, sorting and recycling initiatives.","about.plastic.subtitle":"Raising awareness and educating communities","about.plastic.text2":"Through school programmes, workshops and public events, we encourage everyone, from the youngest to the oldest, to adopt environmentally responsible behaviour.","about.mission.title":"Our mission","about.mission.text":"To protect the environment through concrete action to tackle plastic pollution, biodiversity loss and climate change.","about.vision.title":"Our vision","about.vision.text":"A Côte d’Ivoire — and an Africa — where young people are driving a green, fair and sustainable economy.","about.values.title":"Our values","about.values.text":"Civic engagement, transparency, the inclusion of young people, respect for all living things, and collaboration.","about.history.eyebrow":"Our history","about.history.title":"From passion to action.","about.history.text1":"Founded in 2017 by a group of young Ivorians passionate about the environment, Green Ivory was born out of a simple realisation: plastic pollution and the degradation of ecosystems are threatening our shared future. Since then, we have trained thousands of young people, organised hundreds of field operations and given a voice to the youth of Côte d’Ivoire at major international conferences (COPs).","about.history.text2":"The NGO is led by Khérann YAO, a UNICEF Youth Ambassador for the Environment (2018), supported by a multidisciplinary team and dedicated volunteers.","about.board.eyebrow":"Governance","about.board.title":"The Board of Directors","about.board.intro":"Green Ivory is supported by a Board of Directors and an Executive Committee comprising highly qualified professionals with complementary areas of expertise. label: Textes anglais de l’accueil
value: {"home.hero.eyebrow":"Promoting green jobs","home.hero.intro":"Green Ivory is an Ivorian NGO founded in 2017. We train young people, clean up beaches and advocate for ambitious climate policies in Côte d’Ivoire.","home.axis.eyebrow":"Our action","home.axis.title":"3 key areas that guide our actions","home.axis.intro":"At Green Ivory, our commitment is based on three strategic pillars that guide everything we do, both on the ground and in our advocacy work.","home.axis1.tag":"Axis 1","home.axis1.title":"Plastic pollution","home.axis1.text":"A scourge that has a serious impact on our ecosystems, our oceans and our health. In Côte d’Ivoire, it clogs up towns and damages beaches and waterways. We run awareness campaigns and clean-up operations, and implement waste collection and recycling schemes.","home.axis2.tag":"Axis 2","home.axis2.title":"Biodiversity loss","home.axis2.text":"Deforestation, urbanisation and pollution are threatening ecosystems. We are taking action through reforestation, forest protection and raising awareness of conservation.","home.axis3.tag":"Axis 3","home.axis3.title":"Climate change","home.axis3.text":"Rising temperatures, coastal erosion, erratic rainfall. We give young people a voice at the COPs and promote the green economy.","home.climate.eyebrow":"In the face of the climate crisis","home.climate.title":"Green Ivory is committed to working with and for young people.","home.climate.text":"Rising temperatures, coastal erosion, accelerated deforestation and dwindling water resources. These impacts threaten our environment and our communities. We are taking action on three complementary fronts.","home.climate.p1.title":"Awareness & education","home.climate.p1.text":"Plastic-Free Days and Green Trails programs to train young people and communities.","home.climate.p2.title":"Fieldwork","home.climate.p2.text":"Clean-up operations, recycling and the promotion of the circular economy.","home.climate.p3.title":"Advocacy","home.climate.p3.text":"Conveying young people’s views to decision-makers and COP bodies.","home.about.eyebrow":"Who are we?","home.about.title":"A passionate team, a measurable impact.","home.about.text1":"Green Ivory is an NGO founded in 2017 and based in Côte d’Ivoire. We work to protect the environment through initiatives to tackle plastic pollution, climate change and biodiversity loss — with a particular focus on environmental education for young people and children.","home.about.text2":"The NGO is led by Khérann YAO, Chair of the Board of Directors, who was appointed UNICEF Youth Ambassador for the Environment in 2018.","home.programs.eyebrow":"Our programs","home.programs.title":"Our programs in the spotlight.","home.partners.eyebrow":"Become a partner","home.partners.title":"Please support our organisation, our missions and our activities.","home.partners.text":"Businesses, organisations, NGOs and local authorities — join us in developing sustainable solutions to environmental challenges.","home.values.eyebrow":"Our values","home.values.title":"What drives us.","home.values.intro":"Five core values underpin everything Green Ivory does, both on the ground and in its advocacy work.","home.value1.label":"Passion","home.value1.text":"An energy that spreads: every member acts with enthusiasm and conviction.","home.value2.label":"Agility","home.value2.text":"Responsive teams, attuned to the realities on the ground and to climate emergencies.","home.value3.label":"Integrity","home.value3.text":"Transparency and setting a good example in the management of our resources and programmes.","home.value4.label":"Collaboration","home.value4.text":"Working with communities, partners and institutions — together, never alone.","home.value5.label":"Humanism","home.value5.text":"Putting people first: every action is designed, first and foremost, to serve communities and all living things."}
